name: web-integrations-grid-and-testimonial-bento-with-3d-app-tiles
title: Integrations section with two rows of white app-icon tiles under a grid, and a testimonial bento with a video card
whatItIs: A white page with an 'Integrations' pill, 'Connect integrations you use every day', a logo tile at the top of a faint grid and two rows of white rounded tiles with colourful app icons (Drive, Creative Cloud, Jira, Gmail, Figma, Outlook, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, Intercom...), then 'People just like you are already using ChronoTask' with a bento of white testimonial cards, a chat-bubble tile and a video review card with a play badge.
whatItMeans: Clean and trustworthy; colourful icons on white tiles show breadth without clutter.
techniques: Show integrations as soft tiles with shadows.
Tie tiles to a top logo with grid lines.
Use a bento for quotes with a video card.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded white tile holding an app icon.
A testimonial card with a play button.
A speech-bubble tile outside a card.
